attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop; Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body with green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the actual bareheaded state with short brushed-back wavy grey/silver hair and real grey eyebrows. Maintain the clean understated upper lip and chin with no moustache or beard, and keep the serious closed mouth expression. Retain the actual thin gold/metal rounded spectacles. Dress the figure in a brown/olive open-lapel military coat with a real white/pale shirt collar and light pale khaki/grey necktie. Ensure a clearly rounded short U-shaped lower yellow head that immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline, creating a very short broad neck transition with minimal throat exposure. Avoid any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual open garment and fastening with coherent front/rear collar overlap and contact shadow. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual primary color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. Keep the exact primary mild angle and roll, grey backing light, limited gold lapel and shoulder fittings, and note-limited crop. Ensure all solid surfaces are opaque with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent insignia, text, or accessories; keep tiny spectacle and insignia engraving indefinite and understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED short brushed-back/wavy GREY/SILVER hair and real grey eyebrow HAIR, actual thin GOLD/METAL rounded spectacles, clean understated upper lip/chin and serious CLOSED mouth. BROWN/OLIVE OPEN-lapel military coat, real WHITE/PALE shirt collar and LIGHT PALE KHAKI/GREY necktie. Keep exact primary mild angle/roll, grey backing/light, limited gold lapel/shoulder fittings and note-limited crop, no hidden medal rows. No cap, moustache/chin beard or new accessories; tiny spectacle and insignia engraving indefinite.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
